display_long_description:
Discover Florence like never before in this breathtaking VR experience. Your journey starts at the world-famous Ponte Vecchio, illuminated by the golden hues of the setting sun. Cross the historic bridge and enjoy a serene walk along the riverside arcades of the Arno, soaking in the magical evening atmosphere.

Meander through Florence’s charming alleys to the Piazza della Signoria, where art and history come alive. Marvel at the Loggia dei Lanzi's open-air sculptures, including the iconic Michelangelo’s David, a masterpiece in itself. Take your time exploring the vibrant square and admiring its architectural beauty.

Step into the Palazzo Vecchio, Florence’s grand political and artistic hub. Wander through opulent rooms filled with Renaissance art, frescoes, and intricate details. Visit exhibitions showcasing Florence’s history and immerse yourself in the grandeur of its majestic halls.

Once your tour of the palazzo is complete, step back into the lively Piazza della Signoria and explore the surroundings as the city transitions into night. This VR experience offers a perfect blend of culture, art, and ambiance, immersing you in the soul of Florence from the comfort of your home.
